external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A company that uses the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: A person who receives an invoice email and accesses the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: An agent who works from the support office network and uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used by customer users to manage invoices and related customer and payout information.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console reachable only from the support office network that lets an agent open a billing-app session as a customer user.
processes.source_excerpt: The admin console is reachable only from there

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details. Tables have a company ID column, and the database has no row-level security.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket where the PDF renderer writes PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app to access and update invoicing data.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: invoices, customer records and payout bank details

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows an invoice link and views the invoice, company name, and bank details.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: invoice, company name and bank details

data_flows.name: access tenant database
data_flows.description: The billing app queries and updates the shared tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: invoices, customers and payout bank details

data_flows.name: put render job
data_flows.description: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads the invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID the job carries.

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes the generated PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: PDF, company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDFs
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies

data_flows.name: use admin console
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to and uses the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.authentication: own account and a one-time code

data_flows.name: open customer session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as any customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The customer-company tenant boundary where customer users and payers are situated.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform containing the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database holds confidential data because it contains invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket holds confidential data because it stores generated PDFs from invoices.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the PDF renderer writes invoice-related PDFs to the PDF bucket.

assumptions.assumption: The billing app presents a web interface because people use it in their browser.
assumptions.basis: The source states that people use the billing app in their browser.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF renderer is a non-web process because it consumes queue jobs and renders PDFs rather than presenting an application interface.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the renderer as taking jobs from a queue and writing PDFs.

assumptions.assumption: The admin console presents a web interface because it is a console used for interactive sign-in and session management.
assumptions.basis: The source describes an interactive admin console through which agents sign in and open billing-app sessions.
